foe_core_concepts.central_thesis: Go faster by knowing more, not by caring less - speed and safety are the same capability
foe_core_concepts.expanded_thesis: Organizations need delivery systems that absorb change safely. AI makes FOE doctrine mandatory. Organizations that adopt this will thrive; those that don't will drown in machine-generated chaos.

three_principles.description: Enable humans to comprehend system state quickly through clear signals and cognitive architecture
Provide rapid, actionable feedback loops that enable safe iteration and learning
Build systematic confidence through evidence trails and operating envelopes that enable courage

key_metaphors: The Cockpit Principle - Systems designed for human comprehension
Evidence Trail - Automated verification and audit capability
Operating Envelope - Safe boundaries within which to move fast
The Gauges - Monitoring and observability as cockpit instruments
The Cognitive Triangle - Three principles as unified system

transformation_model.bottleneck_description: The discipline gap where heroic models fail and institutions are required

explicitly_not_for: Pure business executives without technical context
Academics seeking theoretical rigor over practical application

main_themes: Speed and safety as unified capability, not tradeoffs
AI amplifies existing problems in software delivery
Predictable transformation journey with known bottlenecks
Human agency preserved in machine-speed delivery
recurring_patterns: FOE doctrine was always correct, AI makes it mandatory
Systems must move faster than humans can think
DevX as operating system for productivity
